questions.question:
The following graph shows the number of students (in hundreds) in three different courses in four different institutes. Study the graph and answer the question.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7fa0225dd1ec94dbd32d19a763b8d6b0b0c5147483b49752a919ea318ded25e8.png] 

What is the total number of students (in hundreds) in M.Sc. course across all institutes?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

The number of students (in hundreds) in M.Sc. course in institute A = 2.4

The number of students (in hundreds) in M.Sc. course in institute B = 2.9

The number of students (in hundreds) in M.Sc. course in institute C = 5.2

The number of students (in hundreds) in M.Sc. course in institute D = 1.4

Total number of students (in hundreds) in M.Sc. course across all institutes = 2.4 + 2.9 + 5.2 + 1.4 = 11.9

**∴**** The total number of students (in hundreds) in M.Sc. course across all institutes is 11.9.**

questions.question:
Study the given graph and answer the question that follows.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e25853a9f511a3fbcecb1848f1bca4d42c0b3fbb4a021d40f6e8e64b43cf25b.png] 

In which years was the revenue 33 (1)/(3)\% more than the average expenditure of the company during 2014 to 2019?
questions.solution:
**Concept Used-**

Average = Sum of Observations/Number of Observations

**Calculation-**

Average expenditure of the company during 2014 to 2019 = (130 + 150 + 175 + 200 + 165 + 170)/6

⇒ 990/6

⇒ 165

Now, we have to to look for the year in which the revenue is 33 (1)/(3)\% more than 165

33 (1)/(3)\% more than 165 = 165 + 165(33 (1)/(3)\%)

i.e 165 × 4/3

⇒ 220 

∴ The required year is 2018

questions.question:
The following graph shows the number of boys and girls in class V, class VI, class VII and Class VIII. Study the graph and answer the question.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b3134b976dfa70bde4d5238b0339c24b9f41d59719c8c365641aba8e1e40ff37.png] 

The total number of girls is how much per cent less than total number of boys?

(Correct to two decimal places)
questions.solution:
**Formula Used-**

Percentage Difference = (Difference in Value/Base Value) × 100

**Calculation-** 

Total number of boys = 65 + 59 + 60 + 61

⇒ 245

Total number of girls = 58 + 57 + 62 + 59

⇒ 236

Percentage Difference = (245 - 236)/245 × 100

⇒ 3.67%

∴ The total number of girls is 3.67% less than total number of boys.

questions.question:
The given bar graph represents the number of students admitted in four schools (S1, S2, S3, S4) during two consecutive years 2017 and 2018.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1dc593c64bf13c9f43c6fd3a964bd6670ab157f07bb4a0bd917b6b319d767425.png] 

The total number of students admitted in school S3 for both years is approximately what percent of total student admitted in school S2 for both years?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Number of students admitted in school S3 for both years are = 200 and 150 

Number of students admitted in school S2 for both years are = 240 and 360

**Formula:**

x as a percentage of y = (x/y) × 100

**Calculation:**

Total number of students admitted in school S3 for both years are = 200 + 150 = 350

Total number of students admitted in school S2 for both years are = 240 + 360 = 600

∴ Required percentage = (350/600) × 100 = 58.33%

questions.question:
The given bar graph represents the number of students admitted in four schools (S1, S2, S3, S4) during two consecutive years 2017 and 2018.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1dc593c64bf13c9f43c6fd3a964bd6670ab157f07bb4a0bd917b6b319d767425.png] 

What percentage is the average admission of schools S3 and S4 in 2018 of the average admission of schools S1 and S2 in 2017?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Number of students admitted in school S3 in 2018 = 150

Number of students admitted in school S4 in 2018 = 250

Number of students admitted in school S1 in 2017 = 250

Number of students admitted in school S2 in 2017 = 240

**Formula:**

x as a percentage of y = (x/y) × 100 

**Calculation:**

Average admission in school S3 and S4 in 2018 = (150 + 250)/2 = 400/2 = 200

Average admission in school S1 and S2 in 2017 = (250 + 240)/2 = 490/2 = 245

∴ Required percentage = (200/245) × 100 = 81.63%

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7b4cb76b3a0e1ba7ad95f4c16885ab90db40fc602ff4d6b3059e1bd5d25caf1e.png] 

What is the percentage of the total expenditure of the total income?
questions.solution:
Expenditure of the person from April to July

⇒ 7,000 + 13,000 + 25,000 + 10,000 = 55,000

Income of the person from April to July

⇒ 22,000 + 30,000 + 20,000 + 38,000 = 1,10,000

∴ The percentage of the total expenditure of the total income is

⇒ (55,000/1,10,000) × 100 = 50%

questions.question:
The given graph represents the percentage distribution of the total expenditure of a company. Study the graph and answer the question that follows.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/924874063801dbc9eb63e4116a9b419e52181edef4d082db577742025312eb97.png] 

What is the ratio of the total expenditure on 'Infrastructure' and 'Transport' to the total expenditure on 'Taxes' and 'Interest on Loans'?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

The total expenditure on 'Infrastructure' and 'Transport' = 25% + 17.5% = 42.5%

The total expenditure on 'Taxes' and 'Interest on Loans' = 10% + 22.5% = 32.5%

∴ Required ratio = 42.5 : 32.5 = 17 : 13
